item: Spansh system record: biology and points of interest (System targets Known section)
what_to_check: That a body in https://spansh.co.uk/api/system/<id64> lists biology as landmarks with a value (genus as type, species as subtype) and points of interest with a value of 0, and that the rewards match the game
current_value_in_wntb: type/subtype/count/value on each landmark
how_to_verify_in_game: Jump into a system with biology that others have scanned, compare the card's Known rewards and points of interest with the in-game signals and the Spansh page.
notes: Shape seen on live calls on 2026-10-17 for Sol (points of interest) and the bodies search (biology); a full system record with biology was not yet seen.

item: Spansh neutron plotter (Expedition window, Neutron route)
what_to_check: That POST https://spansh.co.uk/api/route with from, to, range, efficiency and supercharge_multiplier returns a job whose result has system_jumps (system, jumps, neutron_star, x, y, z), and that the route matches the in-game galaxy map for the same range
current_value_in_wntb: from, to, range, efficiency (60), supercharge_multiplier (4)
how_to_verify_in_game: Plot Sol to Colonia at your ship's range in WNTB and on Spansh's own neutron plotter page; compare the jump counts and which systems are neutron stars.
notes: Shape seen on one live call on 2026-10-17 (Sol to Colonia, range 40, 169 jumps in 170 entries). Whether 6 is the right overcharge multiplier is not checked.

item: Spansh station search for one system (Mining Book, Market research)
what_to_check: That a station search with a distance of 0 from a system returns the stations in it, each with its whole market and market_updated_at, and that buyers (demand and sell_price above 0) match the in-game commodity market
current_value_in_wntb: distance 0 to 0.01 from the system, market_updated_at within 30 days, first 100 results
how_to_verify_in_game: Run Market research for a system you can visit and compare a buyer's price and demand with its commodity market in the game.
notes: Seen on a live call on 2026-10-17 for Sol (44 stations, all with a market). A system with more than 100 stations shows only the first page.

item: Market.json written after the Market event
what_to_check: That the game sometimes writes Market.json a moment after the journal Market event (or leaves the previous station's file), so a read on the event must check MarketID and retry
current_value_in_wntb: up to 5 reads, 0.1 s apart, only when the first read is not that market's
source: BGS-Tally (a fix for the same problem)
how_to_verify_in_game: Dock and open the commodity market straight away, many times, and watch the EDMC log: how often a first read is not the right market, and how long it takes.
notes: Reported by BGS-Tally; not yet seen in WNTB's own use.

item: Mining: time for a depleted deposit to refill
what_to_check: How long after a deposit is mined out it carries material again, and whether it differs by system
current_value_in_wntb: unknown by default; Settings > Mining can assume a number of days
source: Community field guide for Rhino planetary mining (a public Google document)
how_to_verify_in_game: Mark a deposit depleted, then read its Amount again every day or two and note the days until it is back, in more than one system.
notes: The guide says reformation is confirmed but the timer is unknown, and reports a deposit still depleted after about 7 days.

item: Mining Book: reach for "you are here" and the default stop radius
what_to_check: That ore from a deposit is collected within about 175 m of it (the reach used to pick the deposit you stand at), and that deposits within 1250 m of one another are worked from one parking spot
current_value_in_wntb: 175 m; 1250 m (Settings 500 to 2500 m)
how_to_verify_in_game: Mine a deposit and note how far from it the refined tons still count; plan a stop and check whether the Rhino reaches the other deposits.
notes: Ideas only; the values are WNTB's starting points.
